headline: Iran Expands Regional War Through Proxy Coordination Amid U.S. Naval Constraints
subheadline: Iranian generals coordinate with Hezbollah, Houthis, and Iraqi militias via video during ceasefire, while U.S. Navy operates limited Red Sea forces.
lede: Iranian military coordination with proxies surged during the regional ceasefire, with generals from Hezbollah, Houthis, and Iraqi militias holding video conferences to expand operations. U.S. General Alexis Gerczak warned of insufficient naval forces to protect Israel from ballistic missile threats, as the U.S. Navy deployed only two warships in the Red Sea and one in the Gulf of Oman. Israeli airstrikes destroyed five Hamas weapon depots in Gaza, including one near Shuhada al-Aqsa Hospital. Meanwhile, Russian ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv killed 9 and injured 33, while an explosion in Moscow’s restaurant killed 3 and injured nearly 20.

sections.title: Russian Strikes Escalate Across Ukraine and Moscow
sections.body: Russian ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv caused 9 deaths and 33 injuries, damaging residential and administrative buildings. An explosion at a restaurant in central Moscow reportedly killed 3 people and injured nearly 20. Russian forces advanced near Kostiantynivka and Zalichne, while the Russian military deployed a new type of drone with unknown characteristics. Russia also struck the Yanina container ship and infrastructure at three Russian refineries in Bashkortostan.

sections.title: Iranian Proxy Coordination and U.S. Naval Limitations Intensify
sections.body: Iranian generals coordinated with Hezbollah, Houthis, and Iraqi militias via video conferences during the ceasefire to expand war efforts. U.S. General Alexis Gerczak warned of insufficient naval forces to protect Israel from ballistic missile attacks, with the U.S. Navy operating two warships in the Red Sea and one in the Gulf of Oman. Israeli airstrikes destroyed five Hamas weapon depots in Gaza, including one near Shuhada al-Aqsa Hospital. Iranian officials urged building underground cities for officials to avoid enemy strikes.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iran's coordination with proxies during the ceasefire indicates a deliberate strategy to escalate regional tensions without direct confrontation. U.S. naval limitations in the Red Sea and Gulf of Oman reduce deterrence capabilities, while Israeli strikes on Hamas infrastructure suggest a focus on weakening immediate threats. The risk of spillover into Syria and Iraq remains high due to Iran's regional network. Russian use of a new, unidentified drone type introduces tactical uncertainty, with sustained strikes on urban centers and infrastructure signaling continued operational escalation.
